meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
For a wedding on a budget in India, I’d recommend buying a saree that looks rich in photos, feels comfortable for several hours, and can be worn again for festivals or family functions. You don’t need expensive pure silk to get a beautiful wedding look.

## Best sarees to buy on a budget

![Buy Banarasi Saree in Maroon Online : SSKT619 - Utsav Fashion](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/guHBSWzsNC5NiA-Wdd-CKEylNHRcf3U-WQnmNLtlpQ7zdtTdEC17HLmDKb42HNkWAPJWurhDM3sFaK0eZZE9bjDL9l7rdcmJTjOUiJ31Du11gERGzOGvy7Ir9fLcCnuOfTGIHjpyQEqkQxn_ZxEsn3LZY-mcEzkuFgHuWTWJhUoxYjo54_wSseDJRVnouBE-?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Banarasi-style silk saree**

Approx. ₹1,000–₹2,500

Best for: Wedding ceremonies, traditional family functions and a rich, regal look.

Choose maroon, wine, bottle green or royal blue with gold zari-style motifs. Art silk is usually cheaper than pure Banarasi silk.

---

![Fashion Outfits Sequins Embroidered Georgette Light Pink Saree|SARV128663](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/GfuofRxN-mOO7BlcXW8D1aYxVmE_6FaQSrxGDG-dXYIgV8uSkJiQM_b9DZXjvEBKIQj6eoQizuWXPDGhxB0h-6RzDxXBlendqTykXil7cboRYM1O-1LlXmCXLqu85YCRg8Ysr5-Fl9T7ehbi0GtK70nKMZnjFLqzlgNX4wAgRNUS4kaYVwsoDMs8KSAhTQnj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Georgette or chiffon party-wear saree**

Approx. ₹700–₹1,800

Best for: Sangeet, reception and evening weddings.

Look for light embroidery, sequins or a contrasting blouse. These fabrics drape well and are easier to manage while dancing.

---

![Mimosa Womens Art Silk Saree Kanjivaram Rani Color – http://mimosa.in/](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hTsfYhpAC8EI0dkQs-zshet90ptjnueeyrV6wDS81YDpZ6e6chf0AzUHEVRYiYkiMc_q8h2_veiSCcjyNk5gWnCTPpAeCAcszU3veGUjdtTPNWgkXCVjwzg37sEkqoY_3g_4cKxUeYAjVR_IKnzaMwdIsAbH3xJ-IrDBAUEiXPclxfBduRBkX053OJ0ZVssq?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Kanjivaram-style art silk saree**

Approx. ₹1,200–₹3,000

Best for: Daytime weddings and traditional ceremonies.

Pick a contrasting border, such as pink and green or purple and gold, for a luxurious look without the pure-silk price.

---

![Lavender Floral Embroidered Organza Saree with Scalloped Border | Navayaa](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HWwuZKz1CnLP5sOIhITmnje8mHezpRBzFp-mMkjghJPppgSIIBVUJzBLXE1bpeopdHioIqL3FGLKGXb0hLZgHzc-KGmlTB_ACpBMhVuRjwATSNiLzGAZ-YROYTRJ3Uoecg4c1FyrnvdDsWamOypa4Geu9wnhV3J2GyGzfvgEcydVg-GlbKxMhxStYNc_3UqG?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Organza saree**

Approx. ₹900–₹2,000

Best for: Engagements, daytime receptions and elegant guest outfits.

Floral embroidery and a matching blouse look especially pretty. Choose a lined or less transparent option if you prefer more coverage.

---

![Parampara ~ Handloom Cotton Silk Saree with Golden Border in Exclusive
  

  

  

  
    – verymuchindian.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/izBSspKiZaWWxq6BFfFqLH_HiQLdeCxT0TnHNZwotj6-2dFxGfks9ablGnyA02np8qsoQC4a4jVXRt1T8tTdAhx57BR1HjKVglZvak0pUFp-KslXbjwj7NpWXu24abAAtbcNxYkZfvjVYWe9SZVbE3u7ABJfq0Mo4ZFw3hC6z5vqdYQzUXuLuHx8kG17o4rv?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Cotton-silk blend saree**

Approx. ₹800–₹2,000

Best for: Day weddings, religious ceremonies and repeat wear.

A jewel-toned saree with a gold border is a practical choice if you want something festive without too much sparkle.

These are indicative budget ranges, not verified live prices. Actual prices depend on fabric, workmanship, seller and current discounts.
